description: Unit test class for the DeleteFeaturePropertyStrategy, testing the deletion of feature properties within a 'thing' persistence context in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertyStrategyTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for DeleteFeaturePropertyStrategy, covering various scenarios such as successful deletion and error cases when features or properties are missing.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes static test data before all tests, setting featureId and propertyPointer.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares a new instance of DeleteFeaturePropertyStrategy before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that DeleteFeaturePropertyStrategy instances are immutable.

methods.name: successfullyDeleteFeaturePropertyFromThing
methods.description: Tests successful deletion of a feature property from a thing.

methods.name: deleteFeaturePropertyFromThingWithoutFeatures
methods.description: Tests error handling when deleting a feature property from a thing that has no features.

methods.name: deleteFeaturePropertyFromThingWithoutThatFeature
methods.description: Tests error when attempting to delete a property from a non-existent feature.

methods.name: deleteFeaturePropertyFromFeatureWithoutProperties
methods.description: Tests error when deleting a property from a feature that does not contain properties.

methods.name: deleteFeaturePropertyFromFeatureWithoutThatProperty
methods.description: Tests error when deleting a property that does not exist within a feature.
